# task\-handoff\-id\-collision — Fix handoff id collision on same\-second creation
status: todo  priority: 3  scope: scope-core
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_todo

From the 2026\-08\-15 complete code audit: handoff ids are \`handoff\-\<task\>\-\<from\>\-\<idStamp\(now\)\>\` \(src/core/handoff\.ts:47\) with second\-resolution \`idStamp\`\. Two handoffs for the same task from the same agent within one second collide and the second silently overwrites the first \(writes go to \`handoffs/\<id\>\.json\`\)\. Fix: add a unique suffix \(e\.g\. reuse \`mutationStamp\`'s random suffix or \`postMessage\`'s pattern\)\.
